fields.VATA: Predicted visual thermal affordance, identical to thermal_comfort (number, about 0-5; not degrees Celsius)
fields.heading: Camera heading in degrees (number)
fields.seg_road: Pixel share of roads and paved paths for vehicles (number)
fields.seg_wall: Pixel share of vertical concrete barriers (number)
fields.seg_fence: Pixel share of wood or metal fences (number)
fields.seg_traffic_light: Pixel share of traffic lights. Source column seg_traffic light (number)
fields.seg_traffic_sign: Pixel share of traffic signs. Source column seg_traffic sign (number)
fields.seg_vegetation: Pixel share of plants, trees, and bushes (number)
fields.seg_terrain: Pixel share of bare ground, soil, or rocks (number)
fields.det_traffic_light: Number of detected traffic lights. Source column det_traffic light (number)
fields.det_fire_hydrant: Number of detected fire hydrants. Source column det_fire hydrant (number)
fields.det_stop_sign: Number of detected stop signs. Source column det_stop sign (number)
fields.Canny_Edges: Edge-pixel ratio from a Canny edge detector (number)
fields.Contrast: Difference between light and dark intensity (number)
fields.scene_downtown: Places365 probability of a central business district (number)
fields.scene_apartment_building_outdoor: Places365 probability of an outdoor apartment view. Source column scene_apartment_building/outdoor (number)
fields.scene_residential_neighborhood: Places365 probability of a residential neighbourhood (number)
fields.scene_food_court: Places365 probability of a food court or dining area (number)
fields.scene_parking_lot: Places365 probability of a parking lot (number)
fields.scene_plaza: Places365 probability of a plaza or public square (number)
fields.scene_market_outdoor: Places365 probability of an outdoor market. Source column scene_market/outdoor (number)
fields.scene_promenade: Places365 probability of a promenade or walkway (number)
fields.scene_field_wild: Places365 probability of open natural land. Source column scene_field/wild (number)
fields.scene_forest_path: Places365 probability of a forest path (number)
fields.scene_forest_broadleaf: Places365 probability of broadleaf forest. Source column scene_forest/broadleaf (number)
fields.scene_construction_site: Places365 probability of a construction site (number)
fields.scene_industrial_area: Places365 probability of an industrial area (number)
fields.visual_comfort: Predicted overall visual comfort. City-scale name for the survey dimension comfort (number)
fields.material_comfort: Predicted comfort of surfaces and materials (number)
fields.imageability: Predicted memorability or distinctiveness of the place (number)
fields.human_scale: Predicted human scale of the streetscape (number)
fields.transparency: Predicted visual openness of the streetscape (number)
fields.wealthy: Predicted wealth or upkeep of the place (number)
fields.depressing: Predicted how depressing the place looks (number)
fields.thermal_comfort: Same predicted VATA score as the VATA column: perceived outdoor thermal comfort potential of the streetscape (number)

fields.VATA: Mean VATA of points in this cell (number)
fields.VATA_std: Sample standard deviation (number or null when n = 1)

web_points_json: Array of [longitude, latitude, VATA] rows; scores rounded for display
coverage: Feature columns are present for every point in all eight cities. The website map still draws VATA only.
